camel_example: aliyun ossutil api upload-part-copy --bucket examplebucket --key exampledir/exampleobject/txt --region cn-hangzhou --upload-id 0004B999EF5A239BB9138C6227D69F95 --part-number 10000 --copy-source-if-none-match 5B3C1A2E053D763E1B002CC607C50000 --copy-source-range bytes=100-6291756 --copy-source-if-match 5B3C1A2E053D763E1B002CC607C50000 --copy-source-if-modified-since Fri,_13_Nov_2015_14:47:53_GMT --copy-source /oss-example/_src-object --copy-source-if-unmodified-since Fri,_13_Oct_2015_14:47:53_GMT
description_en: Copies data from an existing object to upload a part
description_zh: 从一个已存在的Object中拷贝数据来上传一个Part
name: UploadPartCopy

parameters.help_en: The full path of the object
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en: The path of the copy source (read permissions are required)
parameters.help_zh: 拷贝源地址（必须有可读权限）
parameters.name: x_oss_copy_source

parameters.help_en:
The number that identifies the uploaded part (partNumber).

Valid values: 1 to 10000.

The size of a single part is limited to 100 KB to 5 GB.
In a multipart upload event, all parts except the last part must be greater than or equal to 100 KB. Because it is uncertain whether a part is the last one, the UploadPart operation does not immediately verify the size of the uploaded part. The size is verified only when CompleteMultipartUpload is called
parameters.help_zh:
每一个上传的Part都有一个标识它的号码（partNumber）。

取值：1~10000

单个Part的大小限制为100 KB~5 GB。
MultipartUpload事件中除最后一个Part以外，其他Part的大小都要大于或等于100 KB。因不确定是否为最后一个Part，UploadPart接口并不会立即校验上传Part的大小，只有当CompleteMultipartUpload时才会校验
parameters.name: part_number

parameters.help_en: The Upload ID that uniquely identifies which object the uploaded part belongs to
parameters.help_zh: uploadId用于唯一标识上传的Part属于哪个Object
parameters.name: upload_id

parameters.help_en:
The byte range of the source object to copy. For example, bytes=0~9 specifies that the first 10 bytes (from byte 0 to byte 9) are copied.
Default value: null.
If this request header is not specified, the entire source object is copied.
If this request header is specified, the response message contains the total length of the file and the copy range. Example: Content-Range: bytes 0~9/44, which indicates that the total file length is 44 and the copy range is bytes 0 to 9.
If the specified range does not conform to the specifications, the entire source object is copied and Content-Range is not included in the response
parameters.help_zh:
源Object的拷贝范围。例如设置bytes=0~9，表示拷贝0到9这10个字符。
默认值：无
不指定该请求头时，表示拷贝整个源Object。
当指定该请求头时，则返回消息中会包含整个文件的长度和此次拷贝的范围，例如：Content-Range: bytes 0~9/44，表示整个文件长度为44，此次拷贝的范围为0~9。
当指定的范围不符合规范时，则拷贝整个源Object，并且不在结果中提及Content-Range
parameters.name: x_oss_copy_source_range

parameters.help_en:
If the ETag value of the source object matches the ETag value provided by the user, the copy operation is performed. Otherwise, HTTP error code 412 (Precondition Failed) is returned.
Default value: null
parameters.help_zh:
如果源Object的ETAG值和用户提供的ETAG相等，则执行拷贝操作；否则返回412 HTTP错误码（预处理失败）。
默认值：无
parameters.name: x_oss_copy_source_if_match

parameters.help_en:
If the ETag value provided does not match the ETag of the object, the file is transferred normally and 200 OK is returned. Otherwise, 304 Not Modified is returned.
Default value: null
parameters.help_zh:
如果传入的ETag值和Object的ETag不匹配，则正常传输文件，并返回200 OK；否则返回304 Not Modified。
默认值：无
parameters.name: x_oss_copy_source_if_none_match

parameters.help_en:
If the time specified in the parameter is equal to or later than the actual modification time of the file, the file is transferred normally and 200 OK is returned. Otherwise, 412 Precondition Failed is returned.
Default value: null
parameters.help_zh:
如果传入参数中的时间等于或者晚于文件实际修改时间，则正常传输文件，并返回200 OK；否则返回412 precondition failed错误。
默认值：无
parameters.name: x_oss_copy_source_if_unmodified_since

parameters.help_en:
If the specified time is earlier than the actual modification time, the file is transferred normally and 200 OK is returned. Otherwise, 304 Not Modified is returned.
Default value: null.
Time format: GMT. Example: Fri, 13 Nov 2015 14:47:53 GMT
parameters.help_zh:
如果指定的时间早于实际修改时间，则正常传送文件，并返回200 OK；否则返回304 not modified。
默认值：无
时间格式：GMT时间，例如Fri, 13 Nov 2015 14:47:53 GMT
parameters.name: x_oss_copy_source_if_modified_since

schema.description_en: The response body of the UploadPartCopy request

CopyPartResult.description_en: The container that stores the UploadPartCopy result

ETag.description_en: The ETag value of the copied object

LastModified.description_en: The time when the object was last modified
